questions.subject: en

My favourite animal is a dog
How to look after a pet dog
Once upon a time there was a dog

The firefighters rescued the cat on Tuesday.

questions.q: Which sentence uses inverted commas correctly?

options: The coach said that I am very proud.
The coach said that he was very proud.
The coach says I was proud.

questions.q: Change to reported speech: "We won the match," said Priya.
options: Priya said that we win the match.
Priya said that they will win the match.
Priya said that they had won the match.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which of these is NOT usually a feature of a newspaper report?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence is a fact rather than an opinion?

questions.subject: en_read

questions.hint: The word describes a feeling.

The rise and fall of your voice

questions.subject: en_read

Leo said that he had found the map.

ipc.topic: Active Planet — Geography: tectonic plates and earthquakes

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: The Earth's outer layer is broken into giant pieces. What are they called?
questions.hint: They fit together a bit like a jigsaw.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Tectonic plates move on top of which layer of the Earth?
questions.hint: It is the hot, slowly moving layer just under the crust.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What is the name of the point on the Earth's surface directly above where an earthquake starts?
questions.hint: The word starts with 'epi', meaning 'above'.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Which instrument detects and records the shaking of an earthquake?
questions.hint: Its name comes from the Greek word for 'shaking'.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: Where do most earthquakes happen?
questions.hint: Think about where plates push, pull or rub.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: About how fast do tectonic plates move?

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What makes tectonic plates move?
options: currents of hot rock in the mantle
questions.answer: currents of hot rock in the mantle
questions.hint: Heat from deep inside the Earth is involved.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: At a destructive boundary, the two plates…
questions.hint: One plate can be pushed under the other.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: At a conservative boundary, the two plates…
questions.hint: They rub side by side.

questions.subject: ipc
questions.q: What is the name of the point underground where an earthquake actually starts?

math.topic: Area of rectangles and estimating irregular areas

only squares less than half covered

questions.q: Escreva a palavra com o acento correto: numero
questions.hint: Fale devagar: nu-me-ro. Qual soa mais forte?

questions.hint: Toda proparoxítona leva acento.

questions.subject: pt_ort

questions.hint: A sílaba forte é a primeira.

questions.q: Qual regra explica o acento de "médico"?
options: Oxítonas terminadas em o são acentuadas
questions.hint: Em qual sílaba está a força?

questions.subject: pt_ort
questions.q: Qual destas palavras NÃO é proparoxítona?
questions.hint: Três delas têm a força na antepenúltima sílaba.

questions.subject: pt_ort
questions.q: Qual frase está com a acentuação correta?
questions.hint: As duas palavras são proparoxítonas.

questions.subject: pt_ort
questions.q: Caça-erros: encontre e corrija as 5 palavras escritas errado.
questions.answer: sabado → sábado; medico → médico; fabrica → fábrica; onibus → ônibus; arvore → árvore
questions.hint: Procure palavras com a sílaba forte na antepenúltima.
questions.text: No sabado, meu tio, que é medico, levou a gente para conhecer uma fabrica de chocolate. Fomos de onibus e descemos perto de uma arvore enorme. Lá dentro, provamos doces de vários sabores e voltamos para casa muito felizes.

questions.subject: pt_ort
questions.q: Caça-erros: encontre e corrija as 4 palavras escritas errado.
questions.answer: ultimo → último; matematica → matemática; pagina → página; numero → número
questions.hint: Toda proparoxítona precisa de acento.
questions.text: No ultimo dia de aula, a professora de matematica pediu que abríssemos o livro na pagina vinte. Cada aluno escolheu um numero e resolveu um problema. Depois, fui estudar no cômodo mais silencioso da casa.
